patches.title: PTB-to-Live Update | The Terrifier
patches.note_zh: 官方在正式上线前公布 The Terrifier 的 PTB-to-Live 调整，重点围绕 Bike Horn、Acid Bottle、Handgun、Torture 时长与若干插件数值，明确 11 月 24 日上线前的最终平衡方向。
patches.note_en: Behaviour outlined the PTB-to-live Terrifier adjustments ahead of launch, focusing on Bike Horn, Acid Bottle, Handgun, Torture duration, and several add-on values as the final balance pass before the November 24 release.
patches.contents: 官方在正式上线前公布 The Terrifier 的 PTB-to-Live 调整，重点围绕 Bike Horn、Acid Bottle、Handgun、Torture 时长与若干插件数值，明确 11 月 24 日上线前的最终平衡方向。

patches.title: 10.2.2b | Backend Patch
patches.note_zh: 10.2.2b 延续 Backend Tunables 的快速热修节奏，官方继续围绕 The Executioner 与 The Good Guy 做小步平衡调整，不等待完整客户端补丁。
patches.note_en: 10.2.2b continues the Backend Tunables hotfix cadence, with Behaviour making another round of small balance adjustments for The Executioner and The Good Guy without waiting for a full client patch.
patches.contents: 10.2.2b 延续 Backend Tunables 的快速热修节奏，官方继续围绕 The Executioner 与 The Good Guy 做小步平衡调整，不等待完整客户端补丁。

patches.title: 10.3.0 | Terrifier PTB Patch Notes
patches.note_zh: 10.3.0 PTB 公布 Terrifier 章节测试服内容：新杀手 The Terrifier、新幸存者 Sienna Shaw、新地图 Hartshorne Mall，以及 gore 自定义和 Mori 系统更新。
patches.note_en: The 10.3.0 PTB introduces the Terrifier chapter with The Terrifier, Sienna Shaw, Hartshorne Mall, and the new gore customization and Mori-system updates.
patches.contents: 10.3.0 PTB 公布 Terrifier 章节测试服内容：新杀手 The Terrifier、新幸存者 Sienna Shaw、新地图 Hartshorne Mall，以及 gore 自定义和 Mori 系统更新。

patches.title: 10.2.2 | Bugfix Patch
patches.note_zh: 10.2.2 延续 10.2.x 的收口节奏，调整 Dark Arrogance，并配套 Lights Out: Stranger Things Edition 及一批地图、角色、UI、活动问题修复。
patches.note_en: 10.2.2 continues the 10.2.x stabilization cycle with a Dark Arrogance retune, the Lights Out: Stranger Things Edition beat, and a broad batch of map, character, UI, and event fixes.
patches.contents: 10.2.2 延续 10.2.x 的收口节奏，调整 Dark Arrogance，并配套 Lights Out: Stranger Things Edition 及一批地图、角色、UI、活动问题修复。

patches.title: 10.2.1 | Patch Notes
patches.note_zh: BHVR patchnotes 落地页当前仍最稳定地指向 10.2.1；该版本加入 Survivor Surrender / Killer End Trial 流程，并配套 Haunted by Daylight 2026 活动规则更新。
patches.note_en: The BHVR patchnotes landing page still most reliably points to 10.2.1, which added the Survivor Surrender / Killer End Trial flow and folded in the Haunted by Daylight 2026 event rules.
patches.contents: BHVR patchnotes 落地页当前仍最稳定地指向 10.2.1；该版本加入 Survivor Surrender / Killer End Trial 流程，并配套 Haunted by Daylight 2026 活动规则更新。

store.name: 黎明杀机
store.short_description: 10年恐惧相伴。10年的惊吓与刺激体验。10年的残暴献祭与惊险逃脱。 永久困于邪恶的幻境之中，即使死亡也无法逃脱，这是一场需要勇气和智慧的较量，四名意志坚定的逃生者在残忍对局中面对嗜血杀手。选择一方，进入多人非对称竞技游戏世界，获得最佳恐怖游戏体验。
store.short_description_en: 10 years of horror. 10 years of jump scares and close calls. 10 years of brutal sacrifices and thrilling escapes. Trapped forever in a realm of eldritch evil where even death is not an escape, four determined Survivors face a bloodthirsty Killer in a vicious game of nerve and wits.
